chip.description: V33A core (uPD70236A) with an integrated timer/counter unit, DMA control unit, interrupt control unit and serial control unit; the DMAU additionally supports a uPD71037/i8237A-compatible mode.
chip.notes: Device table and peripheral notes in src/devices/cpu/v5x.cpp (MAME 0.288): "V53A (uPD70236A) -- V33A (uPD70136A)"; "The V53/V53A DMAU also supports a configurable uPD71037/i8237A mode."
